name: Men’s White Pleated Relaxed Gurkha Pants
description:
Introducing Men’s White Pleated Relaxed Gurkha Pants by Gorur Ghash, designed with a roomy relaxed fit, these pants sit comfortably at the waist and fall straight through the leg, creating a clean, elongated shape. The sharp front pleats add structure while allowing the fabric to open naturally, giving the trousers a balanced look that feels both tailored and easygoing. The crisp white color enhances the refined aesthetic, while the two-button closure with an adjustable waistband allows a more customized and secure fit.

name: Premium Soft Textured Crewneck T-shirt in Payen’s Grey with Thin Stripes
description:
Introducing the latest addition to the premium essentials collection: the Premium Soft Textured Crewneck T-shirt in Payen’s Grey With Stripes by Gorur Ghash. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail and quality, this versatile unisex tee is designed to elevate your everyday wardrobe with its unparalleled comfort and style.

 

At the core of this t-shirt is its thoughtfully engineered fabric: an elevated blend of premium cotton and lycra that redefines everyday comfort. The result is a soft, breathable texture that feels effortlessly smooth against the skin. Enhanced with natural stretch from lycra, the fabric flexes with your movement, offering unmatched freedom without losing its shape. Whether you’re on the move or taking it slow, this tee adapts to your rhythm and delivers a perfect balance of ease, structure, and lasting comfort. The standout feature of this t-shirt is its striking payen’s grey hue, enriched with subtle thin stripes for a touch of sophistication. The rich, warm tone adds depth and character to any outfit, making it a versatile staple for both casual and semi-formal occasions. Pair it with your favorite jeans for a laid-back weekend look, or dress it up with tailored trousers for a refined ensemble that transitions seamlessly from day to night.

 

Designed with a classic crewneck silhouette, this t-shirt offers timeless appeal that never goes out of style. The clean lines and minimalist aesthetic make it a versatile foundation piece that effortlessly complements any wardrobe. Whether worn solo or layered under a jacket or sweater, it adds a polished finishing touch to any ensemble. With its premium construction, superior comfort, and timeless design, the Premium Soft Textured Crewneck T-shirt in Payen’s Grey with Thin Stripes is more than just a t-shirt—it’s a statement of style and quality craftsmanship. Elevate your wardrobe essentials with this must-have piece that promises to become a go-to favorite for years to come. Available in 6 sizes for both men and women on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. A Gorur Ghash original, Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

The Unisex Long Sleeve Oversized Shirt in Brown by Gorur Ghash is your new anchor for effortless earth-toned street style. This isn’t just a basic button-down; it’s a masterclass in relaxed proportions and rugged utility.

 

Crafted from breathable, high-quality cotton, this shirt features a deep brown hue that brings a grounded, versatile edge to any outfit. The unisex, oversized silhouette is defined by dropped shoulders and a straight-cut hem, ensuring a comfortable, gender-neutral fit. This shirt layers perfectly over a tee or stands alone as a statement piece. Functional dual chest pockets add a touch of workwear aesthetic, blending utility with a clean, modern finish. Whether you’re hitting the city streets or keeping it low-key, this unisex shirt is built for those who value both style and substance.

 

Features:

  • Fit: Oversized Baggy Fit, Unisex
  • Silhouette: Dropped Shoulder, Straight Cut
  • Details: Full Sleeve, Button Closure, Classic Collar, Dual Chest Pockets
  • Color: Brown
  • Fabric: Cotton
  • GSM: 130+

Turn heads effortlessly with the Crochet Shirt in Slate Blue with Stripes by Gorur Ghash, a bold twist on classic style and a staple for your next holiday, made for sun-filled days. Crafted from premium polyester, its knitted construction features tiny gaps that allow natural airflow, keeping you cool and comfortable during warm afternoons and relaxed summer outings. The boxy fit creates an easygoing silhouette perfect for beach walks, vacation evenings, or casual city days.

 

Designed with a slightly oversized collar for a modern edge, this crochet shirt blends structure with laid-back style. Wear it open over a tee or buttoned for a refined look. Cool, comfy, and effortlessly bold, turn comfort into a statement with the Crochet Shirt in Slate Blue with Stripes.

description:

Expertly crafted in Bangladesh from premium 100% cotton denim, these jeans offer a heavy-duty feel with a modern, baggy fit. Featuring a durable metal zipper and a classic light blue wash, they provide the perfect blend of 80s nostalgia and contemporary streetwear for any gender.

 

These oversized pants serve as a versatile canvas for any wardrobe. Pair them with a tank for a balanced aesthetic, or lean into the “big-on-big” trend with an oversized shirt. Whether styled with chunky sneakers or sleek boots, the wide-leg cut offers effortless movement and a timeless, relaxed vibe for all genders. While the heavyweight construction provides a structured, high-fashion look, the fabric is treated for an unexpectedly soft hand feel against the skin. From city streets to chill hangouts, these baggy pants get the job done.

name: Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Green
description:
Step away from the restrictive and into a new realm of relaxed sophistication with the Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Green by Gorur Ghash. Consider these your official resignation from the skinny jean olympics. They are a statement of profound comfort and a nod to timeless style, expertly reimagined for the modern wardrobe. Designed for those who value both their personal space and freedom of movement, these pants offer the perfect foundation for a versatile and expressive style. They masterfully blend the laid-back energy of streetwear with the rich, textural heritage of a classic fabric, creating a piece that feels both current and enduringly, effortlessly cool.

 

The soul of these pants lies in their premium, ribbed corduroy construction. The distinct vertical wales of the corduroy provide a satisfying texture that elevates them far beyond ordinary casual wear. This fabric is renowned for its unique combination of softness and durability, offering a comfortable feel against the skin while being robust enough for daily life, from navigating busy city streets to contemplating important life decisions on your couch. The green hue enhances this texture, allowing light to play off the ribs and create a sense of visual depth. It’s a material that feels as good as it looks, promising year-round wearability that adapts to any season with an easygoing grace.

 

Embracing a deliberately baggy fit, these pants are engineered for a silhouette that’s all about an effortless drape. The cut is relaxed through the hip and thigh, freeing you to walk, skate, or execute a spontaneous dance move without a second thought. This isn’t just comfort; it’s about curating a specific, modern look that says “I’m stylish, but I also enjoy breathing.” Functionality is seamlessly integrated with four deep, practical pockets—two at the sides and two at the back. They’re spacious enough for your phone, wallet, keys, and maybe a smuggled croissant for later. These pockets offer the utility you need without disrupting the pants’ clean, relaxed lines, proving that practical can indeed be very cool.

 

Available in 5 sizes (S, M, L, XL & XXL) for men on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram account and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

 

  • Price: ৳1400
  • Features:
    • Color: Green
    • Baggy Fit
    • Single Button Closures
    • Metal Zipper.
    • 4 Pockets.
  • Fabric: Ribbed Corduroy
  • Styling: Pair with a formal button-down shirt or a cuban shirt for a casual look
  • Care Instructions: Hand wash.
  • Made in Bangladesh (BD).

name: Cropped Puffer Jacket in Silver
description:
Channel pure millennium energy with the Cropped Puffer Jacket in Silver by Gorur Ghash. This isn’t just a layer; it’s a full cyber statement. Deeply inspired by the futuristic aesthetic, this jacket features an ultra-shiny metallic finish that demands attention. We cut it in a sharp, unisex crop fit that hits perfectly at the waist, giving you that authentic early 2000s silhouette that pairs flawlessly with high-rise denim or cargo pants.

 

Don’t let the lightweight feel fool you; this puffer is built to keep you warm without weighing you down. It’s finished with essential details like a smooth front zip closure, high stand collar, and firm elastic cuffs to lock in heat and maintain that iconic puffy shape. Whether you’re heading to a rave or just adding some space-age edge to your daily rotation, this jacket is your new go-to.

Channel pure millennium energy with the Cropped Puffer Jacket in Deep Green by Gorur Ghash. This isn’t just a layer; it’s a full cyber statement. Deeply inspired by the futuristic aesthetic, this jacket features an ultra-shiny metallic finish that demands attention. We cut it in a sharp, unisex crop fit that hits perfectly at the waist, giving you that authentic early 2000s silhouette that pairs flawlessly with high-rise denim or cargo pants.

 

Don’t let the lightweight feel fool you; this puffer is built to keep you warm without weighing you down. It’s finished with essential details like a smooth front zip closure, high stand collar, and firm elastic cuffs to lock in heat and maintain that iconic puffy shape. Whether you’re heading to a rave or just adding some space-age edge to your daily rotation, this jacket is your new go-to.

 

Features:

  • Fit: Crop Fit, Unisex
  • Color: Deep Green
  • Fabric: 90% Poly, 10% Polyurethane
  • Fabric GSM: 250+
  • Filling: Cotton, 140 GSM
  • NO POCKETS
  • Features: Full zip closure, High collar, Elastic cuffs.
  • Care: Dry wash only. Do not iron.
  • A Gorur Ghash Original
  • Made in Bangladesh

name: Men’s Straight Fit Carpenter Pants in Black
description:
Men’s Straight Fit Carpenter Pants in Black by Gorur Ghash are where function meets refined style — tough enough for the job, sharp enough for the street. Designed for those who move with purpose, these pants offer the perfect balance between durability and everyday wearability. Whether you’re tackling a task or stepping out casually, this versatile piece is built to perform and look good doing it.

 

Constructed from premium gabardine fabric, these pants deliver a smooth, structured feel that holds up against heavy use while maintaining a clean, polished appearance. The straight fit offers a tailored silhouette without restricting movement — ideal for those who want a classic cut that’s comfortable but not overly relaxed. The rich black tone adds a rugged, earthy character that effortlessly complements work boots, sneakers, or casual loafers.

 

Equipped with six functional pockets, there’s room for everything you need to keep close — from tools to tech. Two spacious front pockets, two back pockets, and two utility-style side pockets provide easy access on the go. Designed with practicality in mind, these carpenter pants also feature a sturdy utility loop, perfect for hanging your hammer or other tools securely while on the move. Whether you’re a craftsman, creator, or someone who appreciates gear with purpose, this detail adds professional-grade functionality to your everyday outfit.

 

The reinforced stitching and strong belt loops are subtle nods to traditional workwear, while the clean lines and structured gabardine elevate the overall look. These Men’s Straight Fit Carpenter Pants aren’t just for the job — they’re for the life that happens around it. Pair them with a basic tee for a rugged everyday look or dress them up with a button-down for utility-inspired style with a modern edge. Built to handle the work. Designed to handle the day. Available in 5 sizes (S, M, L, XL, & XXL) for men on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram account and website. These pants are proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

  • Features:
    • Color: Black
    • Straight Fit
    • 6 Pockets
    • Utility Loop
    • Button Closure.
    • Metal Zipper.
  • Fabric: Gabardine
  • Styling: Wear it casually with your favorite shirt or t-shirt.
  • Care Instructions: Machine wash light.
  • Made in Bangladesh (BD).

And let’s not forget that gorgeous wide-leg silhouette. It’s flowy, chic, and ridiculously comfortable. The drape adds instant elegance, while the black shade keeps things grounded and versatile. Pair them with a casual shirt, a bold polo, or even a casual tee—these pants are the stylish multitaskers your closet has been missing.

name: Women’s High-Waisted Curve Pleated Formal Pants in Muted Brown
description:
Introducing Women’s High-Waisted Curve Pleated Formal Pants in Muted Brown by Gorur Ghash– the pants that finally understand the assignment. These aren’t just your average formal trousers; they’re designed to sit high and stay classy. The high-rise waist flatters your curves while giving you that effortless tucked-in look (without actually trying too hard). Whether you’re running the boardroom or running late to brunch, these pants have your back—and your waist.

 

Made from durable, high-quality polyester, these trousers feel as good as they look. Think soft, breathable, and wrinkle-resistant—aka everything you want when life’s too short for ironing. The fabric holds its shape all day, so you can stay polished from 9 AM meetings to 9 PM dinner plans without a wardrobe change or fashion emergency.

 

Let’s talk pleats—because yes, they matter. The pleated front isn’t just for style (although it does look amazing); it also provides a bit more breathing room where you need it most. That means comfort without the stiffness, and movement without restriction. It’s structure with a soft side—kind of like your favorite mentor or your go-to coffee order. And let’s not forget that gorgeous wide-leg silhouette. It’s flowy, chic, and ridiculously comfortable. The drape adds instant elegance, while the muted brown shade keeps things grounded and versatile. Pair them with a casual shirt, a bold polo, or even a casual tee—these pants are the stylish multitaskers your closet has been missing.

 

Available in 5 different sizes (Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large & Double Extra Large) to suit every body type, finding your perfect fit has never been easier. Step up your style game with these Women’s High-Waisted Curve Pleated Formal Pants in Muted Brown—perfect for staying polished and comfortable from office hours to after-hours. Available for women on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram account and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

 

Price: ৳1700

  • Color: Muted Brown
  • Fabric: Polyester

  • Design: Curve Pleated

  • Wash Instructions: Easy Wash. Wash inside out with similar colors.
  • Made in Bangladesh (BD)

name: Oversized Cropped Shirt in White & Navy Blue
description:
Redefine your streetwear aesthetic with the crisp, modern proportions of the Oversized Cropped Shirt in White & Navy Blue. Blending a classic preppy motif with a boxy, contemporary silhouette, this unisex shirt offers ultimate versatility and effortless coolness.

Made from 100% lightweight cotton with a 140+ GSM weight, the Oversized Cropped Shirt in White & Navy Blue provides all-day breathable comfort and a smooth, structured drape. Designed with a relaxed, boxy cut and dropped shoulders, it features a timeless vertical pinstripe pattern, a sharp pointed collar, white contrast buttons, buttoned cuffs, and a single patch chest pocket. The cropped straight hemline makes it perfect for high-waisted styling, unbuttoned layering over a tank top, or standalone wear with wide-leg trousers. Ideal for warm days and transitional layering, this unisex striped shirt adds a relaxed, modern edge to your modern casual wardrobe.

name: Women’s Paisley Printed String Tie Top in Green
description:
Introducing the Women’s Paisley Printed String Tie Top in Green by Gorur Ghash, where timeless prints meet modern charm. Elevate your everyday style with this chic cropped top, a perfect combination of comfort, femininity, and standout detailing. Designed with a flattering v-neckline and a string tie at the front, this piece allows you to style it your way, whether tied into a neat bow for a polished finish or left relaxed for a breezy, effortless look.

 

The intricate paisley print set against a rich green base brings sophistication with a touch of bohemian flair, making it a unique statement piece for your wardrobe. The cropped silhouette adds a youthful edge and pairs beautifully with high-waisted bottoms. Its lightweight and breathable fabric ensures all-day comfort, giving you ease of movement without compromising on style. The string tie detail adds versatility, letting you adjust the fit to your preference while also creating a subtle accent that enhances the overall design. The v-neckline frames the collarbone elegantly, adding to the feminine appeal and offering a flattering look for all body types.

 

Every element of this top is crafted to capture attention while remaining versatile. The paisley pattern introduces a sense of timeless artistry, making it ideal for brunch outings, casual get-togethers, or even styled up for an evening dinner. Pair it with jeans or tailored pants for a relaxed, chic look, or with skirts for something more feminine and refined. The easy-care fabric ensures durability, breathability, and effortless maintenance, making this a reliable go-to across different seasons.

 

Whether styled solo for a carefree daytime outfit or layered under a jacket for a more polished look, the Women’s Paisley Printed String Tie Top in Green offers an elegant balance of sophistication and ease. Playful yet refined, comfortable yet stylish, it blends character and charm seamlessly. From casual days to semi-formal evenings, this piece ensures you stay confident and fashion-forward, making it an essential addition for women who love versatile and distinctive fashion.

Available in 6 sizes (extra small, small, medium, large, extra large, and double extra large) on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

name: Women’s Long Sleeve Ruffle Top in Off-White
description:
Introducing Women’s Long Sleeve Ruffle Top in Off-White by Gorur Ghash, where ruffles meet effortless elegance. Elevate your everyday style with the Women’s Long Sleeve Ruffle Top in Off-White, a chic blend of comfort, elegance, and playful detailing. Designed with a flattering front button closure, this top flows effortlessly while giving you the flexibility to style it open or closed. The cascading ruffle front steals the spotlight, adding graceful dimension and a textured charm that makes the off-white shade pop with richness. It’s a piece that instantly adds a touch of sophistication to any wardrobe.

 

The ruffle detailing continues with ruffle sleeves that strike the perfect balance between dramatic flair and easy wearability. Crafted from lightweight textured fabric, this top ensures breathability and comfort, keeping it summer-friendly while still looking polished. Each sleeve is finished with a ruffle at the cuff, giving it a feminine flourish and enhancing the overall movement of the top. The airy design allows the sleeves to drape beautifully, creating a fluid movement that adds personality to every outfit. Whether you’re dressing for a brunch outing or an evening dinner, the ruffles make a statement without overpowering your look.

 

Versatility is at the heart of this design. Pair it with sidekick pants for a casual day out, formal pants for the office, or skirts for a more feminine touch. The textured finish of the polyester fabric not only adds depth but also ensures that the top remains lightweight, durable, and easy to maintain. name: Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Off-White
description:
Step away from the restrictive and into a new realm of relaxed sophistication with the Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Off-White by Gorur Ghash. Consider these your official resignation from the skinny jean olympics. They are a statement of profound comfort and a nod to timeless style, expertly reimagined for the modern wardrobe. Designed for those who value both their personal space and freedom of movement, these pants offer the perfect foundation for a versatile and expressive style. They masterfully blend the laid-back energy of streetwear with the rich, textural heritage of a classic fabric, creating a piece that feels both current and enduringly, effortlessly cool.

 

The soul of these pants lies in their premium, ribbed corduroy construction. The distinct vertical wales of the corduroy provide a satisfying texture that elevates them far beyond ordinary casual wear. This fabric is renowned for its unique combination of softness and durability, offering a comfortable feel against the skin while being robust enough for daily life, from navigating busy city streets to contemplating important life decisions on your couch. The off-white hue enhances this texture, allowing light to play off the ribs and create a sense of visual depth. It’s a material that feels as good as it looks, promising year-round wearability that adapts to any season with an easygoing grace.

 

Embracing a deliberately baggy fit, these pants are engineered for a silhouette that’s all about an effortless drape. The cut is relaxed through the hip and thigh, freeing you to walk, skate, or execute a spontaneous dance move without a second thought. This isn’t just comfort; it’s about curating a specific, modern look that says “I’m stylish, but I also enjoy breathing.” Functionality is seamlessly integrated with four deep, practical pockets—two at the sides and two at the back. They’re spacious enough for your phone, wallet, keys, and maybe a smuggled croissant for later. These pockets offer the utility you need without disrupting the pants’ clean, relaxed lines, proving that practical can indeed be very cool.

 

Available in 5 sizes (S, M, L, XL & XXL) for men on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram account and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

name: Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Black
description:
Step away from the restrictive and into a new realm of relaxed sophistication with the Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Black by Gorur Ghash. Consider these your official resignation from the skinny jean olympics. They are a statement of profound comfort and a nod to timeless style, expertly reimagined for the modern wardrobe. Designed for those who value both their personal space and freedom of movement, these pants offer the perfect foundation for a versatile and expressive style. They masterfully blend the laid-back energy of streetwear with the rich, textural heritage of a classic fabric, creating a piece that feels both current and enduringly, effortlessly cool.

 

The soul of these pants lies in their premium, ribbed corduroy construction. The distinct vertical wales of the corduroy provide a satisfying texture that elevates them far beyond ordinary casual wear. This fabric is renowned for its unique combination of softness and durability, offering a comfortable feel against the skin while being robust enough for daily life, from navigating busy city streets to contemplating important life decisions on your couch. The deep black hue enhances this texture, allowing light to play off the ribs and create a sense of visual depth. It’s a material that feels as good as it looks, promising year-round wearability that adapts to any season with an easygoing grace.

 

Embracing a deliberately baggy fit, these pants are engineered for a silhouette that’s all about an effortless drape. The cut is relaxed through the hip and thigh, freeing you to walk, skate, or execute a spontaneous dance move without a second thought. This isn’t just comfort; it’s about curating a specific, modern look that says “I’m stylish, but I also enjoy breathing.” Functionality is seamlessly integrated with four deep, practical pockets—two at the sides and two at the back. They’re spacious enough for your phone, wallet, keys, and maybe a smuggled croissant for later. These pockets offer the utility you need without disrupting the pants’ clean, relaxed lines, proving that practical can indeed be very cool.

name: Women’s Long Sleeve Oversized Button Down Shirt in Navy Blue
description:
The Women’s Long Sleeve Oversized Button Down Shirt in Navy Blue by Gorur Ghash is for those who like their fits roomy and their days breezy. Oversized? Check. Stylish? Double check. Comfy enough to make you question all your other clothes? Absolutely. This shirt is made for movement, mellow moods, and maximum style. Whether you’re heading out or just hanging around, this shirt lets you do both — without compromising an inch of comfort or cool.

 

Crafted from soft, breathable cotton, the Oversized Shirt is basically what dreams feel like. The lightweight fabric makes it perfect for year-round wear, while the roomy silhouette lets you stretch, twist, lounge, or even do interpretive dance in total comfort (we don’t judge). With its drop shoulders and easygoing fit, this shirt isn’t just oversized — it’s generously oversized. It’s the kind of roomy that says, “I came for comfort, but I stayed for the vibe.” You’ll wonder why all shirts aren’t made like this.

 

The shirt features a clean front with a full set of buttons and subtle button-down collars that add just the right amount of structure to the otherwise relaxed vibe. So yes, it’s technically a button-down, just without the stiff, formal feel. The navy blue color adds a calm, versatile tone that pairs well with just about everything in your wardrobe. Style it tucked, untucked, or half-tucked. The Oversized Shirt doesn’t mind. Pair it with your favorite jeans, cargos, or even lungis for that laid-back, put-together look. Basically, if you’re someone who likes big fits and even bigger style, this shirt was quite literally made for you. Go Oversized or go home.

 

Experience the perfect combination of comfort, quality, and style, and make a lasting impression wherever you go. These shirts by Ghash are available in 6 sizes (extra small, small, medium, large, extra large and double extra large) for both men and women on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

name: Pleated Summer Shorts in Cream
description:
Discover the definitive piece for your warm-weather wardrobe with the Pleated Summer Shorts in Cream by Gorur Ghash. Expertly designed for that elusive sweet spot between elevated style and genuine comfort, these shorts present a sophisticated solution for navigating the season’s heat. Let’s call it the official truce in the annual war against sweltering temperatures. They serve as a foundational garment, seamlessly blending the polish of tailored wear with the ease required for daily life, making it an indispensable ally for any summer occasion.

 

The key to its superior performance lies in the high-quality polyester fabric. This carefully selected material is engineered to be exceptionally lightweight and breathable, allowing for optimal air circulation to keep you cool when the weather has other plans. Its advanced moisture-wicking properties diligently draw perspiration away from the skin, ensuring you stay dry and fresh from a morning coffee run to an evening outing.

 

A defining feature of these shorts is the sharp, visible pleating. These are not arbitrary folds; they are intentional, structured details that add a refined dimension to the silhouette. The pleats create a graceful drape that allows the shorts to move with you, offering a flattering fit that’s both forgiving and chic. This tailored element elevates the shorts beyond a simple casual item, lending it an air of intentional design that quietly announces you have your life together, even if you’re just winging it.

 

The timeless cream colorway ensures these shorts are incredibly versatile and almost laughably easy to style. For a classic, minimalist look, pair it with a simple cotton t-shirt or a silk camisole. To create a more structured ensemble for the office or a dinner date, they match effortlessly with a tailored blazer and loafers. Its adaptability makes it suitable for a wide range of settings, proving that one smart garment can indeed solve a multitude of “what to wear” dilemmas. Embrace this blend of refined style and intelligent design, and make summer dressing elegantly simple.

 

Available in 5 sizes for men on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram account and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

  • Features:
    • Color: Cream
    • Pleated Shorts
    • Straight Fit

  • Styling: Pair with a T-shirt.
  • Care Instructions: Machine wash light.
  • Made in Bangladesh (BD).

name: Women’s Long Flannel Skirt in Black and Cream
description:
Introducing the Women’s Long Flannel Skirt in Black and Cream by Gorur Ghash, a versatile and stylish addition to your wardrobe that combines comfort, warmth, and classic charm. Crafted from premium cotton flannel fabric, this skirt is designed to keep you cozy while exuding a relaxed yet sophisticated look. The soft, breathable cotton flannel feels gentle against the skin, making it perfect for all-day wear, whether you’re out for a casual day or a more formal occasion.

 

One of the standout features of this skirt is its adjustable waist, which ensures a perfect fit for every body type. The back of the waist is fitted with elastic, allowing you to customize how snug or loose you want it to be. This flexibility also gives you the option to wear the skirt as a high-waisted piece for a more defined silhouette or at a mid-rise for a laid-back, comfortable style. The elastic waistband provides ease of movement, so you can go about your day without any restrictions. Adding practicality to its design, the skirt comes with two side pockets that offer both functionality and a touch of flair. These pockets are deep enough to carry your essentials like a phone, keys, or small wallet, making them perfect for the modern, on-the-go woman.

 

The elegant black and cream color palette is not only timeless but also incredibly versatile. It pairs beautifully with a variety of tops, from simple tees and shirts to more tailored blouses. The long length of the skirt provides a graceful flow, creating a flattering silhouette that suits all body types. Whether you’re heading to a cozy brunch, a day at the office, or a casual evening outing, the “Women’s Long Flannel Skirt in Black and Cream” is a must-have piece that blends style, comfort, and functionality seamlessly. Elevate your wardrobe with this classic skirt and enjoy its endless styling possibilities.

 

Available in 3 sizes (small, medium, and large) on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

  • Features:

    • Side Pockets

description:
Step into effortless style and comfort with the Men’s Classic Relaxed Fit Pants in White by Gorur Ghash—because who says looking sharp has to feel uncomfortable? These pants are here to prove that you can have the best of both worlds: supreme comfort with a touch of sophistication. Whether you’re heading to a formal meeting or just pretending to be busy at a coffee shop, these pants have got your back (and your legs).

The upgraded design features more pleats than ever before, because let’s be honest, structure matters. These added pleats not only enhance the fit but also give you that well-put-together look, even if you just rolled out of bed five minutes before heading out. Crafted from high-quality polyester fabric, these pants are built to last. The material is lightweight yet durable, ensuring all-day comfort without looking worn out after a few wears. You name it, these pants can handle it.

So, if you’re on the hunt for pants that make you look effortlessly stylish while keeping things ridiculously comfortable, look no further. These relaxed-fit wonders are the perfect blend of style, comfort, and just the right amount of “I woke up like this” charm. The Embroidered Shacket  is a laid-back, unisex piece that’s all about comfort and versatility. Made from 100% cotton, it’s breathable and perfect for layering year-round. The small holes in the fabric add a bit of texture, and the subtle embroidery gives it just enough detail without being too loud. It’s got all the practical features you need, like pockets, sturdy buttons, and a structured collar. Whether you’re pairing it with everyday pants for a casual look or dressing it up with formal pants, this shacket can handle it all.

 

Lightweight and easy to wear, the Embroidered Shacket in Black is perfect for any occasion—whether you’re just hanging out or need something a little more put together. name: Embroidered Shacket in Ochre
description:
Introducing Embroidered Shacket in Ochre by Gorur Ghash– the perfect blend of timeless style and modern charm. Designed for versatility, it’s an effortlessly refined piece that adapts to any occasion, whether you’re dressing up or keeping it casual.

 

The Embroidered Shacket is a laid-back, unisex piece that’s all about comfort and versatility. Made from 100% cotton, it’s breathable and perfect for layering year-round. With its boxy fit, it’s easy to throw on over almost anything or wear on it’s own. The small holes in the fabric add a bit of texture, and the subtle embroidery gives it just enough detail without being too loud. It’s got all the practical features you need, like pockets, sturdy buttons, and a structured collar. Whether you’re pairing it with everyday pants for a casual look or dressing it up with formal pants, this shacket can handle it all. Lightweight and easy to wear, the Embroidered Shacket in Ochre is perfect for any occasion—whether you’re just hanging out or need something a little more put together. The holes and embroidery give it a little personality while keeping things simple. This piece is an easy, stylish go-to for everyday wear. It’s practical, comfortable, and works well with just about anything in your wardrobe.

 

Features:

  • Color: Ochre
  • Fabric: 100% Cotton

name: Women’s Padded Racerback Ribbed Tank Top in Black
description:
Elevate your everyday wardrobe with the Women’s Padded Racerback Ribbed Tank Top in Black—a perfect blend of comfort, style, and functionality. Crafted from a high-quality ribbed fabric, this tank top offers a soft, stretchy fit that hugs your body just right, providing both flexibility and a flattering silhouette. Its breathable material ensures you stay cool and comfortable, whether you’re powering through a workout or lounging at home.

 

Designed with a built-in padding feature, this tank top provides light support, eliminating the need for a bra while offering you the freedom to move confidently. The racerback design adds a sporty yet chic touch, making it a versatile choice for both activewear and casual outfits. The wide straps ensure a secure fit, while the sleek, ribbed texture adds an element of understated elegance. The crisp black color is a timeless classic, making this tank top easy to pair with anything in your wardrobe. Style it with high-waisted jeans for a casual day out, layer it under a blazer for a polished look, or team it up with leggings for a fitness-ready ensemble. Its minimalist design ensures it seamlessly complements any outfit while allowing you to move from the gym to brunch effortlessly.

 

Easy to care for, this tank top is machine-washable and retains its shape and softness even after multiple washes. With its functional features and stylish design, the Women’s Padded Racerback Ribbed Tank Top in Black is an essential addition to every modern woman’s closet. Embrace the perfect mix of style and comfort—your go-to tank top awaits. Available in 4 sizes on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

name: Women’s Flannel Jacket in Brown & Off White
description:
Meet your new go-to for breezy mornings and chilly evenings: the Women’s Flannel Jacket in Brown & Off White by Gorur Ghash. If you thought flannel was just for lumberjacks and cabin stays, think again! This high-quality flannel jacket takes the classic comfort you know and love and gives it an upgrade that’ll make your other jackets feel a little jealous.

 

Crafted from premium flannel fabric, this jacket is soft enough to make you consider canceling your plans just to snuggle up at home (don’t worry, we won’t tell). The brown and off-white plaid pattern is stylishly understated, giving you that perfect blend of rugged and refined. It’s like the jacket version of your favorite cozy blanket, except with sleeves and way more social skills. This jacket isn’t just a pretty face – it’s practical, too. Featuring buttoned cuffs and pockets that can hold more than just vibes (think phone, keys, and maybe a snack or two), it’s the trusty companion for your weekend hikes, coffee shop runs, and casual office days. And with its timeless style, it pairs seamlessly with jeans, chinos, or whatever else you have on standby. Need to look like you didn’t just roll out of bed but still want to feel like you did? This flannel jacket’s got your back – literally.

 

So, if you’re ready to turn heads while staying wrapped in soft, breathable warmth, grab your Women’s Flannel Jacket in Ash & Off White today. Because life’s too short for boring jackets, and you deserve to feel this comfy while looking this good. Now, go ahead and make everyone think you have your life (and your wardrobe) together! These jackets by Ghash are available in 6 sizes (extra small, small, medium, large, extra large and double extra large) for both men and women on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

name: Corduroy Jacket in Navy Blue
description:
Infuse your outerwear collection with tactile warmth and timeless vintage flair in the Corduroy Jacket in Navy Blue by Gorur Ghash. Combining classic utilitarian appeal with a modern casual edge, this unisex piece delivers easy warmth and effortless, everyday sophistication.

Crafted from premium ribbed corduroy fabric, the Corduroy Jacket in Navy Blue features soft vertical wale ridges that create rich visual texture and durable, structured warmth. Designed in a comfortable regular fit, it features a classic pointed collar, a sturdy front button closure, buttoned chest flap pockets, side welt pockets, and buttoned cuffs for a clean, tailored drape. The navy blue tone offers an earthy, versatile shade that layers seamlessly over t-shirts, hoodies, or knit sweaters while pairing effortlessly with denim, chinos, or cargo pants. Perfectly balancing retro texture with modern utility, this unisex navy blue corduroy jacket is a must-have outerwear staple for cool-weather outings and layered seasonal looks.

name: Women’s Racerback Ribbed Tank Top in Black
description:
Introducing the epitome of comfort and style: the Women’s Racerback Ribbed Tank Top in Black by Gorur Ghash. This sleek and versatile tank top is crafted from premium ribbed cotton to ensure a flattering fit and unmatched softness. Whether you’re hitting the gym, lounging at home, or stepping out on a sunny day, this racerback tank is your perfect companion.

 

The standout feature of this tank top is its racerback design, which not only enhances freedom of movement but also adds a touch of sporty elegance to your look. The carefully contoured armholes and neckline provide a comfortable and secure fit, making it ideal for all-day wear. The fabric is a high-quality ribbed cotton blend, which offers breathability and durability. It feels wonderfully soft against the skin and drapes beautifully for a flattering silhouette. This tank top is designed to be versatile—pair it with leggings for an athletic vibe, style it with jeans for a casual outing, or layer it under a jacket for a chic ensemble.

 

The vibrant Black color of this tank top adds a refreshing pop to your wardrobe. It’s a shade that exudes confidence and individuality, making it a must-have for those who like to stand out. The color complements a range of skin tones and can be easily coordinated with other pieces in your closet. This racerback tank is not just about looks—it’s about functionality too. It’s perfect for workouts, offering the flexibility and support needed for yoga, running, or weight training. The racerback style ensures that your shoulders have full range of motion during any activity.

 

Care for this tank top is effortless. Simply machine wash it with like colors and tumble dry low for best results. The fabric retains its shape and color even after multiple washes, ensuring that it stays looking fresh and new for a long time. For those seeking a blend of comfort, style, and functionality, the Women’s Racerback Ribbed Tank Top in Black is a wardrobe essential. Elevate your everyday style with this versatile piece and experience the difference in quality and design. Available in 6 sizes on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Perfect for warm-weather getaways, evening outings, or stylish weekend hangouts, this short-sleeve button-up transitions seamlessly across casual occasions. name: Women’s Wool Blend Overcoat Jacket in Black
description:
Introducing the suave, dashing Women’s Wool Blend Overcoat Jacket in Black by Gorur Ghash! This isn’t just your average overcoat—it’s a style statement that brings warmth and panache together in perfect harmony.

 

Crafted with a blend of thick wool and cozy cotton, this overcoat is your ticket to weathering the chilly days in style. Imagine wrapping yourself in a cloud of warmth, feeling as snug as a bug in a rug while exuding an air of sophistication—yes, this overcoat does it all. The sleek black hue adds an air of mystery and versatility to your ensemble. Whether you’re strolling through the city streets or making a grand entrance at a formal soirée, this jacket effortlessly elevates your look, making heads turn and hearts skip a beat.

 

Its tailored design ensures a flattering fit, accentuating your silhouette without compromising on comfort. The thick wool blend not only keeps you toasty but also withstands the elements, ensuring durability that lasts through seasons of wear. Equally suited for your daily grind or your weekend escapades, this overcoat is the epitome of versatility. Pair it with your sharpest suit for a boardroom-ready look or throw it over a casual ensemble for a touch of refined flair—this jacket’s got your back, literally and figuratively.

 

So, if you’re seeking warmth, style, and a sprinkle of charm, look no further than the “Women’s Wool Blend Overcoat Jacket in Black.” It’s not just an overcoat; it’s your new cold-weather confidant, your style enhancer, and your go-to piece for sophistication with a hint of humor. These overcoats by Ghash are available in 4 sizes (small, medium, large, and extra-large) for both men and women on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

 

  • Price: ৳2600
  • Features:
    • Color: Black
    • Chunky Button-Front
    • Unisex
    • Side Pockets
    • Liner Inside
    • Full Sleeve
  • Fit: Regular fit.
  • Fabric: Thick wool-blended cotton
  • Styling: Wear it casually (buttoned or unbuttoned)
  • Care Instructions: Dry wash only
  • Made in Bangladesh (BD)

Upgrade your cold-weather rotation with the timeless sophistication of the Long Sleeve Ribbed Navy Blue Turtleneck Pullover. Blending classic warmth with a sleek, modern texture, this unisex pullover offers cozy comfort and sharp everyday style.

Crafted from a high-density cotton-polyester blend with a heavy 300+ GSM weight, the Long Sleeve Ribbed Navy Blue Turtleneck Pullover delivers superior warmth, breathable softness, and structured durability. Designed in a universally flattering regular fit, it features a soft-finish ribbed fabric that stretches comfortably while maintaining its shape. The high turtleneck collar provides cozy coverage against chilly winds, while elastic cuffs and hem ensure a clean, tailored finish. Its deep navy blue hue makes it an indispensable layering essential, effortless to style under a coat, structured blazer, or worn on its own with dark denim and tailored trousers. Combining functional warmth with low-key sophistication, this unisex turtleneck pullover brings timeless charm to your winter wardrobe.

name: Women’s Corduroy Jacket in Bright Lavender
description:
Elevate your style with our Women’s Corduroy Jacket in Bright Lavender by Gorur Ghash, a striking and fashionable addition to your wardrobe that seamlessly merges classic design with a modern twist. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail and exceptional craftsmanship, this jacket is a true standout piece that will redefine your sense of style.

Made from high-quality, fine-wale corduroy fabric, this jacket offers a luxurious and velvety texture that feels soft to the touch. The bright lavender color adds a contemporary twist to this timeless textile, giving it a fresh and vibrant appeal. This corduroy jacket is exceptionally versatile and stylish, making it the ideal choice for a range of occasions. Whether you’re heading to the office, meeting friends for a night out, or enjoying a casual weekend brunch, this jacket effortlessly complements your personal style, ensuring you always look your best. Designed with a tailored fit, it not only enhances your silhouette but also provides a high level of comfort, striking the perfect balance between style and functionality. The jacket features practical elements such as two spacious front pockets for convenient storage and inner pockets for safely stashing your valuables.

The classic button-up front closure exudes a sense of sophistication, while the buttoned cuffs add both style and practicality to the overall design. Every stitch is executed with precision, ensuring that this jacket is built to last, allowing you to enjoy it for years to come. The bright lavender color is a refreshing departure from the typical earthy tones of corduroy jackets, allowing you to express your individuality and stand out with a unique and eye-catching choice. Elevate your wardrobe and make a statement with the Women’s Corduroy Jacket in Bright Lavender. Whether paired with jeans, chinos, or slacks, this jacket is the perfect choice for adding a touch of sophistication to your outfit. It’s a harmonious blend of timeless charm and contemporary flair, ensuring that you’re always on-trend.

Invest in a jacket that not only keeps you warm but also leaves a lasting impression. Elevate your style game with the Women’s Corduroy Jacket in Bright Lavender today! These jackets by Ghash are available in 4 sizes (small, medium, large, and extra-large) for both men and women on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

name: Gift Cards
description:
Unleash the Power of Choice with Our Gift Cards by Gorur Ghash.

Looking for the perfect gift that’s guaranteed to delight, every time? Look no further. Our Digital Gift Cards offer a world of endless possibilities, providing the recipient with the power to shop and explore our website to their heart’s content. Make the choice to let your loved ones make the choice with our Gift Card. Show you care, and give the gift of freedom and thoughtfulness. Here’s what makes our Gift Cards truly exceptional:

 

No Limits, No Expiry, No Worries:
With our Digital Gift Cards, there are no strings attached. There’s no usage limit, no expiration date, and absolutely no rush to redeem. Your recipient can take their time, carefully selecting the items that matter most to them. This gift keeps on giving until the balance is used up, ensuring a long-lasting and joyful shopping experience.

 

Digital Delight Straight to Your Inbox:
Gone are the days of waiting for physical gift cards in the mail. Our Digital Gift Cards are delivered directly to the recipient’s email inbox, making the process quick, convenient, and eco-friendly. Just provide us with the recipient’s email address, and we’ll handle the rest.

 

Thoughtful and Stress-Free:
Choosing the right gift can be a nerve-wracking experience, fraught with the fear of getting it wrong. Our Gift Card eliminates that stress. It’s a thoughtful and considerate way to express your love without the burden of decision-making. You’re saying, “I care about your happiness, and I respect your unique tastes.”

 

Unlimited Design and Value Options:
We believe in making gifting as personal as possible. That’s why our Digital Gift Cards come in a variety of designs and denominations to suit every occasion. From stylish and elegant to fun and festive, there’s a design to match your recipient’s tastes. Plus, we offer flexibility for the gift amount – you can choose from preset values or enter any amount that suits your budget and the recipient’s preferences.

 

Endless Shopping Awaits:
Our website is a treasure trove of products and experiences, from the latest tech gadgets to fashionable clothing, gourmet delights, home decor, and so much more. With a Digital Gift Card in hand, your loved one can explore and shop for exactly what they desire, ensuring your gift is truly meaningful and cherished.

Give the gift of choice with our Digital Gift Cards, and watch your loved ones’ faces light up with joy. It’s the perfect present for birthdays, holidays, special occasions, or simply to express your appreciation. Order one today, and let the shopping adventures begin!

 

Perfect for All Occasions:
Whether it’s a birthday, an anniversary, a holiday, or simply a day to say, “I’m thinking of you,” our Gift Card is versatile and fits every occasion. It’s also a brilliant option for corporate gifting, demonstrating your appreciation for employees or clients while letting them choose the perfect reward.

In essence, our Gift Card is a beautiful paradox: a gift that’s simultaneously personal and versatile. It’s a testament to your love and thoughtfulness, a token of freedom for your loved ones to select what their heart desires, and ultimately, a celebration of the uniqueness of the recipient. So, when you’re unsure about what to gift but sure about your love, our Gift Card is your best choice.”

Make the choice to let your loved ones make the choice with our Gift Card. Show you care, and give the gift of freedom and thoughtfulness.

name: Women’s Georgette Pleated Flowy Top in Black
description:
Hey there fashionistas! Are you ready to take your wardrobe game to the next level? Look no further than the Women’s Georgette Pleated Flowy Top in Black by Gorur Ghash!

 

This top is the ultimate power player – it’s perfect for both the office and the weekend. The flowy design will have you feeling like a true fashion icon, while the white color gives it a touch of sophistication and class.

 

But let’s talk about the pleats – they’re like the icing on the cake, adding a touch of sweetness to an already stylish top. Plus, they’re perfect for hiding any extra holiday indulgences (we won’t judge, we’ve all been there). And the georgette fabric? Don’t even get us started. It’s light as a feather, so you’ll feel like you’re wearing nothing at all (cue the “Simpsons” reference). But it’s also durable, so you won’t have to worry about any wardrobe malfunctions when you’re tearing up the dance floor.

 

Speaking of dance floors, this top is perfect for any occasion. Dress it up with some statement jewelry and heels for a fancy dinner, or pair it with some sneakers and jeans for a casual brunch with the girls. But don’t just take our word for it – the Women’s Georgette Pleated Flowy Top in Black is a favorite among fashion bloggers and influencers alike. You’ll be getting compliments left and right when you wear this bad boy out and about.

 

So what are you waiting for? Add the Women’s Georgette Pleated Flowy Top in Black to your cart now and get ready to take on the world (in style, of course).

Available in 5 sizes (small, medium, large, extra large and double extra large) on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram accounts and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

name: Plaantik 10 Year Commemorative Blackout Unisex Tee
description:
Introducing Plaantik 10 Year Commemorative Blackout Unisex Tee in collaboration with Gorur Ghash!  This exclusive limited-edition streetwear hass been launched to celebrate the 10-year anniversary of the football media company. The unique all-black T-shirt embodies the football fandom of Bangladesh and Plaantik’s journey over the decade.

The black-out concept of the t-shirt resonates with the idea that football fandom starts for the country when the lights go out. Throughout the last decade, Plaantik aimed to provide the passionate football fanbase with the latest news and live updates, occasionally through entire nights; so, they only found it fitting to release an all-black streetwear to commemorate ten years of their relationship with the fans.

Like Plaantik, Gorur Ghash has been a prominent name among the youth; so, the fusion between the two brands has been seamless in coming up with the concept. The t-shirt features the well-known emblems of Plaantik and Gorur Ghash sewn in solid black in the front. The stylized and recognizable typeface for “Plaantik” is embossed in black across the chest and features a Roman “X” on the back of the shirt to mimic a football jersey.

Plaantik 10 Year Commemorative Blackout Unisex Tee will only be available for purchase during a 3-day window on Gorur Ghash’s website starting November 4th, 2021.

  • Fabric: Premium quality Lycra cotton mix fabric. Light and breathable.
  • Features: Mono-colored half-sleeve t-shirt. Crew neck. Regular fit. Plaantik and Gorur Ghash logo embroidered. Text printed using the highest quality.
  • Styling: Recommended to be styled on its own with jeans, trousers and shorts.
  • Sizes: 0 Year Commemorative Blackout Unisex Tee comes in 5 sizes: Small, Medium, Large, Extra-Large, Double XL.
  • Care Instructions: Machine wash.
  • Made in Bangladesh.

FAQ


– I ordered the wrong size, can I change it? 

The Plaantik x Gorur Ghash collaboration is strictly limited with a small number of units available for purchase. Due to a high demand, it is crucial that you select the size carefully. Please use the tee shirt chart provided to avoid any confusion. Unless there is a major defect with the product, unfortunately we can’t exchange or give you a refund. 

– Do you deliver outside Dhaka? 

Yes! Gorur Ghaah will deliver the product to you via delivery partners. Please select the appropriate option at checkout. Please note that delivery outside Dhaka will cost Tk. 100 per delivery. 


– Do you delivery outside Bangladesh? 

Yes! Through our delivery partners, you can get your product outside Bangladesh. However, due to the global pandemic, there may be longer wait times and logistical issues. You can place the order here – Click Me

name: Premium Basic Black Crewneck T-shirt
description:
Redefine your daily essentials with the sleek simplicity and lasting comfort of the Premium Basic Black Crewneck T-shirt. Perfectly balancing a crisp silhouette with a flexible drape, this unisex tee brings effortless modern style to any outfit.

Crafted from a 200 GSM blend of cotton and Lycra, the Premium Basic Black Crewneck T-shirt delivers breathable comfort with enhanced shape retention and flexibility. Cut in a classic regular fit, it features a structured crew neckline, well-fitted half sleeves, and a deep, solid black colorway. Designed to retain its structured shape and deep color through repeated wear, it functions seamlessly as an easy solo piece with denim or as a clean foundation under overshirts and jackets. Durable, soft, and infinitely versatile, this unisex black crewneck is an essential building block for any modern outfit.

Features:

  • Fit: Regular fit

  • Silhouette: Classic short-sleeve crewneck t-shirt silhouette

  • Color: Black

  • Fabric: Cotton + Lycra Mixed (95% Cotton, 5% Lycra)

  • GSM: 200

  • Pattern: Stripe

  • Details: Crewneck collar and half sleeves

  • Wash Instructions: Follow the care label.

  • A Gorur Ghash Original

  • Made in Bangladesh
